name: stage_b_final_curriculum_v1
purpose: Frozen thesis-training protocol after architecture audit

curriculum.name: static_recovery
curriculum.description: Fixed UE map and fixed full fleet. Learn basic Access/Relay spatial coordination.

curriculum.name: spatial_generalization
curriculum.description: Random UE hotspot and random UAV initial positions; fleet remains fully available.

curriculum.name: dynamic_fleet_recovery
curriculum.description: C2 spatial randomization plus a random low-battery UAV, random dropout time, automatic return/charging, and rejoin.

ablation.from_scratch: Train the same QMIX architecture directly on C3 for the same total number of environment episodes as C1+C2+C3.

notes: No reward changes between curriculum stages.
No ETA-to-active feature in the frozen core method.
Final reporting uses held-out scenarios and multiple seeds.
